_comment: Text decks to load into the deck library (data/deckLibrary.json). Files are relative to this folder. A deck already in the library (same legend and the same cards, whatever its label) is skipped, so this is safe to re-run. Apply with scripts/riftbound/add-deck-to-library.mjs --manifest (server running) or scripts/riftbound/deck-library-file.mjs --manifest (server stopped); scripts/deploy/update-ingest.sh picks the right one.
